29791-the-most-sentimental-man.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. At this Johnson almost forgot that anger no longer had any validity. By "loved ones" Clifford undoubtedly had meant Elinor and Paul. It was true that Johnson had had a certain affection for his wife and son when they were alive; now that they were dead they represented an episode in his life that had not, perhaps, been unpleasant, but was certainly over and done with now.

arxiv-2006-12632.title: Towards Contrastive Explanations for Comparing the Ethics of Plans
arxiv-2006-12632.creator: Benjamin Krarup, Senka Krivic, Felix Lindner, Derek Long
arxiv-2006-12632.description: Abstract The development of robotics and AI agents has enabled their wider usage in human surroundings. AI agents are more trusted to make increasingly important decisions with potentially critical outcomes. It is essential to consider the ethical consequences of the decisions made by these systems.

arxiv-2102-06508.creator: Teguh Budi Prayitno
arxiv-2102-06508.description: Abstract We investigated the dependence of N e ´ \acute{\textrm{e}} el temperature as a critical temperature on the electric field and hole-electron doping in the antiferromagnetically ordered zigzag graphene nanoribbon. The temperature was calculated by averaging the magnon energy in the Brillouin zone within the mean-field approximation.

arxiv-2108-09767.title: A Boosting Approach to Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2108-09767.creator: Nataly Brukhim, Elad Hazan, Karan Singh
arxiv-2108-09767.description: Abstract Reducing reinforcement learning to supervised learning is a well-studied and effective approach that leverages the benefits of compact function approximation to deal with large-scale Markov decision processes. Independently, the boosting methodology (e.g. AdaBoost) has proven to be indispensable in designing efficient and accurate classification algorithms by combining inaccurate rules-of-thumb .

arxiv-2110-04121.title: On the Limitations of Multimodal VAEs
arxiv-2110-04121.creator: Imant Daunhawer, Thomas M. Sutter, Kieran Chin-Cheong, Emanuele Palumbo & Julia E. Vogt
arxiv-2110-04121.description: Abstract Multimodal variational autoencoders (VAEs) have shown promise as efficient generative models for weakly-supervised data. Yet, despite their advantage of weak supervision, they exhibit a gap in generative quality compared to unimodal VAEs, which are completely unsupervised. In an attempt to explain this gap, we uncover a fundamental limitation that applies to a large family of mixture-based multimodal VAEs.

arxiv-2111-07789.title: Super-weakly coupled U(1) z and GeV neutrinos Thanks: Presented at Matter to the Deepest 2021 conference.
arxiv-2111-07789.creator: Timo J. Kärkkäinen 1 and Zoltán Trócsányi 1,2
arxiv-2111-07789.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Timo J. Kärkkäinen 1 and Zoltán Trócsányi 1,2. The super-weak force combines three simple extensions of the Standard Model, one in gauge sector, one in fermion sector and one in scalar sector. Each of these extensions are well motivated by their rich phenomenology. Combined to a single framework, they can explain several open questions in particle physics and cosmology: the origin of dark matter, cosmic inflation, matter-antimatter asymmetry, neutrino masses and vacuum stability.

arxiv-2203-02223.title: Topological unidirectional guided resonances emerged from interband coupling
arxiv-2203-02223.creator: Xuefan Yin, Takuya Inoue, Chao Peng, Susumu Noda
arxiv-2203-02223.description: Abstract Unidirectional guided resonances (UGRs) are optical modes in photonic crystal (PhC) slabs that radiate towards one side without the need for mirrors on the other, represented from a topological perspective by the merged points of paired, single-sided, half-integer topological charges.

arxiv-2308-11694.title: Modular curves X 0 ​ ( N ) X_{0}(N) with infinitely many quartic points
arxiv-2308-11694.creator: Maarten Derickx, Petar Orlić
arxiv-2308-11694.description: Abstract . We determine all modular curves X 0 ​ ( N ) X_{0}(N) with infinitely many quartic points. To do this, we define a pairing that induces a quadratic form representing all possible degrees of a rational morphism from X 0 ​ ( N ) X_{0}(N) to a positive rank elliptic curve.

arxiv-2312-09650.title: Madtls : Fine-grained Middlebox-aware End-to-end Security for Industrial Communication Conference: ACM Asia Conference on Computer and Communications Security; July 1–5, 2024; Singapore, Singapore ACM Asia Conference on Computer and Communications Security (ASIA CCS ’24), July 1–5, 2024, Singapore,
arxiv-2312-09650.creator: Eric Wagner, David Heye, Martin Serror, Ike Kunze, Klaus Wehrle, Martin Henze
arxiv-2312-09650.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Eric Wagner, David Heye, Martin Serror, Ike Kunze, Klaus Wehrle, Martin Henze. Industrial control systems increasingly rely on middlebox functionality such as intrusion detection or in-network processing. However, traditional end-to-end security protocols interfere with the necessary access to in-flight data. While recent work on middlebox-aware end-to-end security protocols for the traditional Internet promises to address the dilemma between end-to-end security guarantees and middleboxes, the current state-of-the-art lacks critical features for industrial communication.

arxiv-2312-12081.title: Torsional Constitutive Relations at Finite Temperature
arxiv-2312-12081.creator: Manuel Valle, and Miguel Á. Vázquez-Mozo
arxiv-2312-12081.description: Abstract The general form of the linear torsional constitutive relations at finite temperature of the chiral current, energy-momentum tensor, and spin energy potential are computed for a chiral fermion fluid minimally coupled to geometric torsion and with nonzero chiral chemical potential. The corresponding transport coefficients are explicitly calculated in terms of the energy and number densities evaluated at vanishing torsion.

arxiv-2401-09806.title: Reheating constraints on mutated hilltop inflation
arxiv-2401-09806.creator: Sudhava Yadav, Dhwani Gangal, K.K. Venkataratnam
arxiv-2401-09806.description: Abstract Future research studies of cosmic microwave background polarization seems likely to provide a more improved upper bound of r ≤ 0.03 r\leq 0.03 on the tensor-to-scalar ratio(r). In our work, we have done the reheating study of mutated hilltop inflation(MHI), a model falling in the broad category of small field inflation.

arxiv-2404-02370.title: Enhancing Human-Computer Interaction in Chest X-ray Analysis using Vision and Language Model with Eye Gaze Patterns
arxiv-2404-02370.creator: Yunsoo Kim, Jinge Wu, Yusuf Abdulle, Yue Gao, Honghan Wu
arxiv-2404-02370.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yunsoo Kim, Jinge Wu, Yusuf Abdulle, Yue Gao, Honghan Wu. Recent advancements in Computer Assisted Diagnosis have shown promising performance in medical imaging tasks, particularly in chest X-ray analysis. However, the interaction between these models and radiologists has been primarily limited to input images. This work proposes a novel approach to enhance human-computer interaction in chest X-ray analysis using Vision-Language Models (VLMs) enhanced with radiologists’ attention by incorporating eye gaze data alongside textual prompts.

arxiv-2409-03439.title: KiloBot: A Programming Language for Deploying Perception-Guided Industrial Manipulators at Scale
arxiv-2409-03439.creator: Wei Gao, Jingqiang Wang, Xinv Zhu, Jun Zhong, Yue Shen, Youshuang Ding
arxiv-2409-03439.description: Abstract We would like industrial robots to handle unstructured environments with cameras and perception pipelines. In contrast to traditional industrial robots that replay offline-crafted trajectories, online behavior planning is required for these perception-guided industrial applications. Aside from perception and planning algorithms, deploying perception-guided manipulators also requires substantial effort in integration.

arxiv-2505-24239.title: An Adversary-Resistant Multi-Agent LLM System via Credibility Scoring
arxiv-2505-24239.creator: Sana Ebrahimi, Mohsen Dehghankar, Abolfazl Asudeh
arxiv-2505-24239.description: Abstract While multi-agent LLM systems show strong capabilities in various domains, they are highly vulnerable to adversarial and low-performing agents. To resolve this issue, in this paper, we introduce a general and adversary-resistant multi-agent LLM framework based on credibility scoring.

arxiv-2507-10209.title: Is Micro-expression Ethnic Leaning?
arxiv-2507-10209.creator: Huai-Qian Khor 3 , Yante Li 3 , Xingxun Jiang 2 , Guoying Zhao 3 1
arxiv-2507-10209.description: Abstract How much does ethnicity play its part in emotional expression? Emotional expression and micro-expression research probe into understanding human psychological responses to emotional stimuli, thereby revealing substantial hidden yet authentic emotions that can be useful in the event of diagnosis and interviews.

arxiv-2601-02508.title: Fermi Sets: Universal and interpretable neural architectures for fermions
arxiv-2601-02508.creator: Liang Fu
arxiv-2601-02508.description: Abstract We introduce Fermi Sets , a universal and physically interpretable neural architecture for fermionic many-body wavefunctions. Building on a “parity-graded” representation fu2025 , we prove that any continuous fermionic wavefunction on a compact domain can be approximated to arbitrary accuracy by a linear combination of K K antisymmetric basis functions—such as pairwise products or Slater determinants—multiplied by symmetric functions.

pmc-10593915.creator: Ioakeim Sapantzoglou, Zacharias Fasoulakis, George Daskalakis, Marianna Theodora, Panagiotis Antsaklis
pmc-10593915.description: Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) is a heterogeneous chronic, multisystem, inflammatory autoimmune disorder with variable clinical features, with its manifestations being attributed to the presence of multiple autoantibodies and their subsequent autoimmune reactions. Multiple organs may be involved, with the kidneys, the joints, and the skin being the most common, increasing maternal and fetal morbidity and mortality.

pmc-11432004.title: O-GlcNAcylation: Crosstalk between Hemostasis, Inflammation, and Cancer
pmc-11432004.creator: Itzel Patricia Vásquez Martínez, Eduardo Pérez-Campos, Laura Pérez-Campos Mayoral, Holanda Isabel Cruz Luis, María del Socorro Pina Canseco, Edgar Zenteno, Irma Leticia Bazán Salinas, Margarito Martínez Cruz, Eduardo Pérez-Campos Mayoral, María Teresa Hernández-Huerta, Paula Guedes de Pinho, Arun Dh
pmc-11432004.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). O-linked β-N-acetylglucosamine (O-GlcNAc, O-GlcNAcylation) is a post-translational modification of serine/threonine residues of proteins. Alterations in O-GlcNAcylation have been implicated in several types of cancer, regulation of tumor progression, inflammation, and thrombosis through its interaction with signaling pathways. We aim to explore the relationship between O-GlcNAcylation and hemostasis, inflammation, and cancer, which could serve as potential prognostic tools or clinical predictions for cancer patients’ healthcare and as an approach to combat cancer.

pmc-11494044.title: Emergence of cyclic hypoxia and the impact of PARP inhibitors on tumor progression
pmc-11494044.creator: Martina Conte, Vanesa Cabeza Fernández, F. Javier Oliver, Tomás Alarcón, Juan Soler
pmc-11494044.description: Tumor hypoxia is a dynamic phenomenon marked by fluctuations in oxygen levels across both rapid (seconds to minutes) and slow (hours to days) time scales. While short hypoxia cycles are relatively well understood, the mechanisms behind longer cycles remain largely unclear.

pmc-11703401.title: Giant Chiari’s Network in Healthy Adults
pmc-11703401.creator: Yuko Harada, Atsuo Mori
pmc-11703401.description: A 40-year-old male visited our clinic for cardiac evaluation. He had palpitations for several years, but the reason was unknown. Transthoracic echocardiography revealed a hyperechoic ribbon-shaped structure that moved vigorously in the right atrium. A contrast CT scan was not able to detect any abnormal structure in the right atrium. Giant Chiari’s network was suspected.

pmc-12612014.title: Air pollution exposure and the burden of pediatric upper respiratory tract infections in emergency departments: a retrospective time-series study
pmc-12612014.creator: Ewelina Wawryk-Gawda, Nadia Miga-Orczykowska, Joanna Matusiak, Dominika Mańdziuk, Kamila Giżewska, Violetta Opoka-Winiarska
pmc-12612014.description: Upper respiratory tract infections (URTI) are a major public health problem and a leading cause of pediatric Emergency Department (ED) visits. Approximately 81% of emergency outpatient visits in children are due to URTI, and respiratory diseases account for 12% of all deaths worldwide. Air pollution is considered an important factor contributing to the increased incidence of respiratory infections.

pmc-13619810.creator: Rommel Gutierrez, Aracely Mera-Navarrete, Ana Cristina Villegas, Vanessa Guevara, William Villegas-Ch

pmc-13624160.title: Season-specific nitrogen management shapes soil microbial communities and crop productivity in wheat–maize rotation system
pmc-13624160.creator: Mengru Xue, Wenyang Li, Haosen Wei, Zerong Wang, Baojin Guo, Chuangyun Wang, Peng Zhou, Fei Gao
pmc-13624160.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Based on a long-term positioned field experiment in a wheat-maize double-cropping system, the regulatory mechanisms of nitrogen fertilizer legacy on soil-crop coordination and microbial functions remain unclear. A two-year field experiment was conducted with four treatments: CK: no N fertilizer applied during either wheat or maize seasons; W1M0: N carryover only during the winter wheat season; W0M1: N carryover only during the summer maize season; W1M1: N carryover during both wheat and maize seasons.
